caption: The drawing depicts a geometric composition composed primarily of red, beige, blue, brown, black, and white shapes. In the center, there is a six-pointed star made up of diamond and triangle shapes with varying patterns, including blue and white diagonal stripes, small brown motifs on beige, and black and white stripes. Surrounding the central star, there is a hexagonal arrangement of red triangles, each with a concentric triangular design inside. The outermost area consists of alternating triangles and diamond shapes, featuring different patterns such as beige with brown florals, red checkered patterns, black with small red and white dots, white with brown grid lines, diagonal stripes, and plain beige. The overall arrangement forms a square composition with the repeating shapes and patterns creating a quilt-like appearance.
title: Shaker Quilt Pattern
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
